description: Tuning split for the gap planner. Hand-authored on 7 September 2026 before any run against it, with a different persona, different systems, and different facts from phase0.json so nothing overlaps. Used to choose the gap prompt and gap model. phase0.json remains the test set and is evaluated once after tuning.
